Journal (Transactions) Class

gxdJournal makes writes to several database files all or nothing, and in 7.3 and 7.4 feeds replication through its ship log.

Contents

Overview
Transactions
Replication (7.3, 7.4)

Overview

Attach every file a transaction writes (gxDatabase files, gxBtree indexes, a gxVectorIndex's Database()), then Begin(), write, and Commit() or Rollback(). The journal records each batch of pages and its commit before the pages reach the files, so after a crash the next Open() (or Recover()) finishes every committed batch and drops the rest. Open the journal before the files.

Replication (gxrepl): EnableShipLog() appends each commit's pages to the set's ship log, and an open record when the writer starts; EnableObjectNotes() adds which records each commit added, changed and removed (for derived_apply = incremental). Readers in another process take a gxdJournalReadLock to see whole batches only. See the replication administrator's guide. The examples: journal_recovery, replication.

Transactions

gxDatabaseError Open(const char *jname) / Close()

Recovers, then opens the journal; Close() rolls back an open batch or checkpoints, and truncates the journal file.

gxDatabaseError Attach(gxDatabase *f) / Attach(gxBtree *btx) / Attach(BtreeCache *cache)

Adds a file to the journal's transactions.

gxDatabaseError Begin() / Commit(int durable = 1) / Rollback()

Starts a batch, commits it (synced when durable), or undoes it (a gxVectorIndex then needs Reload()).

gxDatabaseError Checkpoint()

Writes the committed pages to the files and empties the journal.

static gxDatabaseError Recover(const char *jname, unsigned long *recovered = 0) / unsigned long Recovered() const

Finishes the committed batches a stopped writer left; the count of batches replayed by Open().

void SetWriteMode(gxdJournalWriteMode mode) / void SetWriteLock(int lock)

When committed pages reach the files (write through or write back); the write lock that gxdJournalReadLock readers wait for.

Replication (7.3, 7.4)

gxDatabaseError EnableShipLog(const char *set_root, const char *stream = 0) / void DisableShipLog() / gxdShipLog *ShipLog()

Appends each commit to the set's ship log (an open record first); the log, for SetExclude() (derived indexes) and SetCommitBlock().

gxDatabaseError EnableObjectNotes(int on = 1)

Adds an objects record before each commit record: which records it added, changed and removed (off by default; GXDSHIP_OBJECTS=1 turns it on).
